The room is modern with white walls and grey floor-to-ceiling curtains. (2) The male continues singing with high emotional expression, opening his mouth wide and squinting his eyes. The female in the background turns slightly, her face partially visible in the lit circular vanity mirror. She appears to be applying makeup or styling her hair.
